spec.title: Flow: ZAP design and data prototype

status.comment: Opt-in design; autonomous execution is not implemented by this package.

p.SELECTION: ZAP is a draft successor methodology for campaigns with interactive initial design and extended autonomous execution. Loading or installing this package does not select it for a campaign, replace a multi-user-planning context, activate a mandate, or authorize execution. An existing central coordinator remains authoritative until the owner explicitly selects a supported migration.

p.SCOPED-READING: For ZAP design work, use zap-draft and read ZAP-METHODOLOGY.xml. For the implemented local data prototype, use zap-state and its command contract. Read ZAP-DATA-AND-VIEWER.xml for data architecture or integration design. The research map is rationale, not a runtime instruction dependency. Workers with explicit packets keep their packet scope; this flow does not make them central coordinators.

p.CAPABILITIES: The package contains research, planned methodology, and a bounded Python reference data kernel. It provides no campaign runner, trusted owner-control adapter, native facts adapter, server or UI. A draft event or stop simulation cannot grant authority, accept product work or dispatch a worker. Future runtime capabilities require their own implemented and verified contracts.

p.CANON: Methodology: spec://org.vibevm.world/zap/flows/zap/ZAP-METHODOLOGY#root. Data and future viewer: spec://org.vibevm.world/zap/flows/zap/ZAP-DATA-AND-VIEWER#root. Research: spec://org.vibevm.world/zap/research/zap/IDEA-MAP#root.
